articles.title: DFDV Continues Accumulating SOL as Treasury Growth Rises to 12% since August 12; CHAD Hits Record Highs Despite Crypto Selloff
articles.description: Continued purchases and organic accumulation drive approximately 12% growth in SOL holdings since the Company’s August 12 Earnings Update CHAD offers a 13% annual dividend rate supported by a productive SOL treasury BOCA RATON, FL, Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its treasury increased by approximately 22,070 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,586,282 SOL and SOL equivalents. The latest increase brings total SOL and SOL equivalents growth to approximately 12% since the Company’s Q2 earnings report on August 12. With the recently established $300 million at-the-market offering program (the "CHAD ATM”) providing an additional source of growth capital, the Company believes its SOL accumulation flywheel is continuing to gain momentum. "Short-term volatility has not changed our conviction or our commitment to accumulating SOL,” said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "Tokenized equities are generating billions of dollars in trading activity on Solana, stablecoin adoption is reaching new highs, and just last week Samsung announced it is bringing stablecoin functionality across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices. These developments point toward a much larger role for Solana in global finance, and we intend to keep accumulating and compounding SOL ahead of that opportunity.” CHAD Hits All-Time Highs Despite Crypto Selloff CHAD (Nasdaq: CHAD), the Company’s variable-rate perpetual preferred stock, reached new all-time trading highs and gained during the week ended October 9, 2026, despite a broader cryptocurrency selloff. "CHAD reaching new highs and approaching $10.00 even as SOL pulled back is an encouraging sign that investors are recognizing its distinct income proposition,” said Dan Kang, Chief Strategy Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "We created CHAD to meet demand for income supported by a productive SOL treasury, and its recent performance demonstrates how its trading behavior can differ from SOL’s. For common shareholders, CHAD provides a funding source that can support accretive SOL per share growth without issuing additional common shares. For CHAD holders, it offers daily income supported by that growing, productive treasury.” CHAD currently carries a 13% annual dividend rate on its $10 stated amount, equivalent to $1.30 per share annually at the current rate, with dividend payments continuing each business day when declared. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad. For more information, visit defidevcorp.com. To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog. About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service. articles.title: Nigeria: Outsourcing the Presidency, One Infirmity at a Time
articles.description: By Chidi Anselm Odinkalu Nearly 20 years ago, while stumping for his party, the Peoples’ Democratic Party (PDP), outgoing President Olusegun Obasanjo decided to confront head-on morbid rumours about the health of his hand-picked successor. Umaru Musa Yar’Adua, then governor of Katsina State and the president’s man for the job, was said to be stricken in […] The post Nigeria: Outsourcing the Presidency, One Infirmity at a Time appeared first on Global News Network Liberia.

articles.title: England hand out record number of central contracts ahead of Ashes and World Cup
articles.description: With the retirements of former captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Mark Wood freeing up significant funds, the ECB have handed deals to 39 players.
